title: Rack Recipes
description: Plan a homelab from 12 self-hosted services, choose ports and storage, and export or reopen the Compose file.

data_info.detail: Upstream container guides supply the images, ports and data paths. The planner estimates memory for your selections.

readme.note: Plan a media server or monitoring stack from 12 services, change ports and storage, and reopen the exported Compose file later.

title: Switchboard
description: Build a local front door for your NAS, DNS console and other services.

data_info.detail: Your local JSON service directory supplies the links.

readme.note: Add your NAS and other services to a private JSON file using group, name and URL fields, then reload to see changes. Use hostnames resolvable by your other devices; anyone who can reach the dashboard can see its links.

title: Vhost Logbook
description: Summarize requests, status codes and traffic from Apache access logs.

data_info.detail: Your Apache access log supplies the dates and request counts.

readme.note: Pass an Apache access log filename, or pipe a decompressed archive to standard input, to compare daily traffic and individual HTTP status codes. Check the skipped-line count before interpreting a report; exit status 1 means some lines could not be read as log records.

title: LANWatch
description: Ping your devices and keep a local history of when they were reachable.

data_info.detail: Your own host probes are timestamped in a local SQLite database.

readme.note: Add a router or NAS by name, run check, then inspect status and history or export recent samples to CSV. A DOWN result means the ICMP probe failed; sleeping devices and hosts that block ping can still have working services.

title: Archive Shelf
description: Find early Canadian internet survey results by page or search your own collection.
requirements: Python 3, SQLite FTS5 and Poppler for PDFs

data_info.detail: Nine complete issues of Statistics Canada’s The Daily provide 75 searchable pages published from July 2001 to September 2010.
data_info.install_detail: The Linux edition indexes your own PDF newsletters in a local SQLite database.

readme.note: Search “dial-up” to compare page 2 of the July 26, 2001 issue with page 5 of the September 23, 2003 issue. Open the PDF at either page or download the matching citations.

title: Waystation
description: Capture websites into portable archives, map links and browse offline.
requirements: Downloadable executable for Linux, macOS or Windows

data_info.detail: Website captures and their timestamps live in your local archive.

readme.note: Capture a site before and after a change, then compare the two snapshot IDs to see which URLs appeared, disappeared or changed content.

title: Timefold
description: Import a personal timeline, connect dated records and browse the files attached to each event.

data_info.detail: Your records and timeline spreadsheets populate the archive. An optional collection links seven dated W3C recommendations.

readme.note: Import a timeline CSV with dates and titles. Reopening the same file skips existing records, including capsules you have since edited.

title: Tape Index
description: Fingerprint and verify scans, web archives and game saves from the terminal.

data_info.detail: The index records a SHA-256 checksum for each file you choose so you can verify it later.

readme.note: Create a manifest outside a stable collection, keep a trusted copy, and verify the collection after copying it to another disk. Renamed files appear as missing and added; changed bytes are detected even when file size and timestamps stay the same.

title: DNS Lens
description: Look up website, mail and exact-name DNS records, compare resolvers and compare saved reports.

data_info.detail: Choose Google or Cloudflare for current DNS replies. Full reports include registration data, and saved JSON comparisons run in your browser.

readme.note: Download a DNS report before changing a domain, repeat the lookup afterwards and open the earlier JSON to see which answers changed at the same resolver.

title: IP Snapshot
description: See ports, hostnames and vulnerability identifiers from passive InternetDB observations.

data_info.detail: Shodan InternetDB returns observations for one public IP without observation dates.

readme.note: Enter a public IP address and export its InternetDB observations as JSON for comparison later. The lookup never probes the target; its retrieval time is not the date Shodan scanned a reported port or vulnerability.

title: Certificate Trail
description: Trace issued certificates, names, issuers and dates across certificate transparency logs.

data_info.detail: Certificate records come from a live crt.sh search or a JSON file you import.

readme.note: Enter a domain, then filter certificate names and issuers or export matching records as CSV. If the live query fails, import a crt.sh JSON array for the same domain; validity dates and CT history do not establish current deployment or revocation status.

title: Domain Biography
description: Follow a domain's life from registration through certificates and archived captures, with transfers, changes and quiet years on one timeline.

data_info.detail: Your browser asks IANA's RDAP registry, crt.sh certificate logs and the Wayback Machine directly when you look up a domain.

readme.note: Enter a domain such as cira.ca, or paste a full URL. A subdomain is looked up under its registered name at the registry. The timeline marks each event with its source. A quiet period means two or more years in which no source recorded anything, which often points to a parked, lapsed or re-registered domain. Compare that span with the registration date: a "Registered" date after the first archive capture usually means the name expired and someone registered it again. Use "Copy link" to share a lookup, or download the report as Markdown or JSON.

title: Renewal Board
description: Track when your domains and their certificates expire, spot missing transfer locks and DNSSEC, and export a renewal calendar.

data_info.detail: Your browser asks each domain's registry through RDAP, and optionally crt.sh, for expiry dates when you check your list.

readme.note: Paste your domains, one per line, and choose "Check renewals". Rows are sorted by urgency. "Act now" means a registration expires within 30 days (or already has), the domain is in redemption or on hold, or its certificate expires within a week. "Soon" means a registration within 90 days or a certificate within three weeks. "Check" covers a missing transfer lock or unsigned DNSSEC. Download the .ics file to put every expiry in your calendar with reminders 30 and 7 days before. The list is kept only if you tick "Remember this list".

title: Route Archaeologist
description: Trace observed BGP origins by IP prefix or ASN.

data_info.detail: RIPEstat supplies historical route observations for your selected dates.

readme.note: Enter an IP, prefix or ASN with a UTC date range, select a returned prefix and inspect its observed origins or AS paths. The RPKI link checks current authorization even when the routing observation you selected is historical.

title: RPKI Guard
description: Check whether a route origin ASN and prefix are authorized by published ROAs.

data_info.detail: RIPEstat checks the submitted prefix and origin ASN on demand.

readme.note: Submit an ASN and prefix to inspect the validation result and covering authorizations. A shared link only fills the form; select Validate to send it to RIPEstat, and distinguish an unauthorized origin from a prefix that exceeds the allowed length.

title: Outage Scope
description: Explore network disruptions and compare the measurement signals behind them.

data_info.detail: Georgia Tech IODA supplies outage signals for a window of up to 30 days.

readme.note: Try the July 2022 Rogers AS812 example and compare routing visibility, probing and background traffic over the same UTC window. Missing samples or an empty detection list do not establish network health; follow the linked source evidence.

title: Broadband Atlas
description: Explore reported coverage, funding and nearby radio licences, with provincial plan prices.

data_info.detail: ISED maps broadband coverage and funded projects across Canada’s provinces and territories.

readme.note: Choose a province, search a community or coordinates, and build a location report to compare coverage, nearby projects, spectrum records and provincial pricing. Grid-centre distances and area coverage estimates do not confirm service or speeds at a particular address.

title: Telecom Pulse
description: Compare local broadband coverage with the provider offers behind each provincial price average.

data_info.detail: CRTC coverage estimates use census areas. Plan prices come from offers in named survey communities.

readme.note: Open the Oxford example, then expand the provider offers and switch between 2024 and 2025. The province’s survey average changes with the mix of offers in Bear River, Mahone Bay and Wedgeport.

title: Onion Pulse
description: Explore changes in Tor use and compare spikes with documented network events.

data_info.detail: Tor estimates clients from directory requests. Event notes and daily values help explain unusual counts.

readme.note: Open the October 2026 Canada event to compare the peak against nearby days, download the daily values, and read why older Tor clients inflated request counts.

title: Blocked or Gone?
description: Investigate interference and test coverage in public OONI measurements.

data_info.detail: OONI case studies supply the historical measurements, and a daily check updates the Canadian Discord example.

readme.note: Open a case and compare its daily measurement outcomes, then follow the evidence into OONI Explorer. Use the lookup form for another domain and country; an anomalous measurement alone does not establish intentional blocking.

title: Packet Detour
description: Inspect Canadian traceroute measurements and annotate the hops in your own route.

data_info.detail: RIPE Atlas recorded the Vancouver and Montréal routes to K-root on October 1, 2025. You can also enter your own hop notes.

readme.note: Compare measured hop timings from Vancouver and Montréal, open the exact RIPE Atlas result, then annotate known countries and see where a route’s evidence runs out.

title: Protocol Cabinet
description: Find slow HTTP requests, read DNS answers and follow recorded email delivery hops.

data_info.detail: Inspect a local HAR, DNS JSON or email header, or request a live HTTP or DNS response.

readme.note: Open a browser HAR and sort by slowest request, inspect the answer rows in a DNS Lens export, or open an email’s original headers to read its recorded handoffs in delivery order.

title: Tracker X-Ray
description: Inspect HAR waterfalls, compare individual requests and create a reduced capture for sharing.

data_info.detail: HAR files and measured page timing are processed locally; captured URLs are never replayed.

readme.note: Inspect this page’s load, or import your own HAR to see its request waterfall and metadata. Compare two captures by endpoint or exact URL, then inspect individual changes. Make a sanitized copy to remove values, bodies and vendor fields; review what remains before sharing it. All capture processing stays in your browser.

title: Header Autopsy
description: Inspect HTTP headers, understand status codes and compare dated response captures.

data_info.detail: Inspect pasted headers, a local HAR or a dated HTTP redirect and its final response.

readme.note: Paste headers or open a HAR locally, then inspect its HTTP status context and security-header checklist. Status notes distinguish cache validation, authentication, rate limits and gateway failures, with direct specification links. A code alone does not establish why a request failed. Use Gov Grade for dated MDN provider grades and TLS evidence.

title: Mail Path
description: Trace the relay hops and authentication results recorded in the headers of an email you received.

data_info.detail: Open an email or paste its original headers. Relay times and reported authentication results are read locally.

readme.note: Copy the Received and Authentication-Results fields from a message you received, including indented continuation lines. The timeline shows which servers recorded each hop and the delay between their timestamps.

title: Packet Pocket
description: Compare capture traffic, inspect both directions of a conversation and export filtered packet or aggregate reports.

data_info.detail: Your browser reads local PCAP and PCAPNG files. A second capture supplies aggregate rates and protocol shares for comparison.

readme.note: Compare two captures by protocol share and traffic rate, then select a conversation in the first capture to see its two directions. Export a filtered aggregate report to share counts and relative time bins without addresses or hostnames.

title: Dependency X-Ray
description: Inspect dependency lockfiles and query advisories for selected packages.

data_info.detail: Inspect your lockfile or compare two published project manifests. Optional OSV lookups send only the packages and versions you select.

readme.note: Compare pip 25.3 and 26.3, then filter for unchanged versions or inspect earlier versions no longer present. The package lists record what pip bundled in each release.

title: Exploit Graveyard
description: Search Canadian Cyber Centre notices and see which cited vulnerabilities also appear in CISA KEV.

data_info.detail: Cyber Centre alerts and advisories are matched to CISA’s known-exploited catalogue by the CVE identifiers printed in each Canadian notice.

readme.note: Open AV25-769 to see the Cyber Centre’s November 18, 2025 Fortinet notice. Expand its cited identifier, CVE-2025-58034, to see CISA’s listing date and the Canadian notices that name the same CVE. Use Patch Signal for the affected-version record and recent FIRST EPSS estimates when reviewing a specific CVE.

title: Patch Signal
description: Check CVE shortlists against known exploitation, inspect affected versions and follow patch guidance.

data_info.detail: CISA KEV shortlist matching runs locally; individual CVE records and FIRST EPSS estimates load on request.

readme.note: Paste CVE identifiers from your inventory or a bulletin to match up to 250 distinct IDs against the saved CISA known-exploited catalogue. Open an identifier for affected-version records, patch guidance and FIRST EPSS estimates. Not listed in KEV does not mean safe, and an ID match does not establish that your installed version is affected.

title: FraudPulse Canada
description: Explore Canadian fraud reports, losses, police-reported cybercrime and business cyber security data.

data_info.detail: RCMP fraud records and newer CAFC summaries, Statistics Canada police and business tables, and CISA exploited-vulnerability data; checked weekly with separate coverage dates.

probes.label: CAFC extract coverage

notice_if.text: The detailed CAFC extract is delayed; newer national summaries are available in a separate view.

probes.notice: The detailed CAFC extract is delayed; newer national summaries are available in a separate view.

readme.note: Start with Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre reports and filter by receipt date, province, category or contact method; compare reporting frequency with reported dollar losses. Newer national CAFC summaries have a separate view: for example, open the 2026 half-year investment loss and follow its topic link to older detailed Investment records, without splicing the figures into one time series. Police incidents, business survey estimates and global exploited vulnerabilities have separate views and denominators. Source-check dates mean that publication was checked, not that new incidents were published; the Sources view records coverage, limitations and snapshot changes.

title: RegistrarWatch
description: Compare reported phishing domains across registrars, adjust for portfolio size and trace each registrar across quarters.

data_info.detail: Eight gTLD registrars are tracked in Interisle quarterly phishing data. Load a public source CSV locally for the full table.

readme.note: Search a registrar name or IANA ID, then select its row to compare quarters. Rates are per 10,000 managed gTLD domains. Start with eight tracked registrars or load the publisher’s original CSV locally to explore all published registrar rows for that quarter.

title: ScamTrace
description: Trace Canadian scam warnings and takedowns through dated public records, then add your own observations.

data_info.detail: Reviewed notices from Canadian venues, regulators and public bodies, with optional timeline entries kept in the current tab.

readme.note: Compare Capilano’s warning with Manitoba’s Rotor Investments alert to see which source actually confirms a domain suspension. Add dated observations to a case in the current tab and export its timeline before leaving.

title: AbusePulse
description: Explore Canadian spam reporting and enforcement trends across CRTC reporting periods.

data_info.detail: Reviewed six-month snapshots from the CRTC Spam Reporting Centre and CASL enforcement reports.

readme.note: Choose one of 12 reporting periods to inspect online-form message channels, SMS spam types, ranked scam categories and published enforcement measures. Compare half-years by intake, weekly average, notices to produce or preservation demands. Download a long-form CSV with original category labels, units, qualifiers and official source links. The records panel links to an existing ISED release summary and identifies the missing monthly phishing counts and category definitions for a focused CRTC request.

title: PhishIntel
description: Explore Canadian phishing advisories, impersonation reports and measured outcomes from the Cyber Centre.

data_info.detail: Selected Canadian public advisories and 10 cumulative quarterly observations from the Cyber Centre’s phishing study.

readme.note: Compare cumulative outcomes in the Cyber Centre’s study of phishing against cloud sign-ins, then search official Canadian publications by topic, publisher or evidence type. Download the study table or filtered citations as CSV. Each research question points back to the publication that leaves it open.

title: ATIP Records Explorer
description: Find released records, request copies, or draft an access request.

data_info.detail: Federal departments publish summaries of completed access-to-information requests in English and French.

readme.note: Search completed federal ATIP summaries by keyword and institution, save useful records, then export the current result page or your saved shortlist as CSV. The export includes both languages, official record links and the snapshot date; it is not the full result set unless you have saved every match.

title: Government Memory Map
description: Find record classes and personal information banks to reference in an access request.

data_info.detail: Six federal Info Source inventories describe the records and personal information banks each institution holds.

readme.note: Save relevant record classes or Personal Information Banks, choose one institution, and edit its request outline before copying or downloading it. Government-wide references are optional and need an applicability check against that institution’s inventory.

title: The Briefing Room
description: Search briefing note titles and reference numbers.

data_info.detail: Federal departments publish briefing note titles, reference numbers and the institutions that prepared them.

readme.note: Save briefing references across searches, then select an institution to draft a request containing its saved notes. Follow the ATIP Explorer link to look for an earlier release; the briefing register provides titles and metadata rather than the documents themselves.

title: Evidence Lab
description: Find the page that answers a question in a PDF and export its citation, excerpt and your notes.

data_info.detail: Two guided questions use Nova Scotia’s 230-page 2020 bridge disclosure. You can also open a searchable PDF privately in your browser.

readme.note: Choose the Allain Creek question to find the April 20, 2020 Level 1 and July 16, 2019 Level 2 inspection dates on physical PDF page 2. Choose Annapolis Tidal Gate for page 3. Inspect the rows, pin the supporting lines, add your own note and download a Markdown brief with the release record and physical page citations.

title: The ATIP Popularity Index
description: See which released records received the most informal copy requests.

data_info.detail: Treasury Board records how often people request copies of previously released access-to-information packages.

readme.note: Choose a reporting period and search a topic, reference or institution to find packages whose copies were requested. Counts describe that informal-request channel and period, not unique readers or the date the original records were released.

title: ATIP Metrics
description: Compare institutional workloads, find related records and briefing notes, and build a request draft.

data_info.detail: Treasury Board workbooks report access and privacy requests by institution and fiscal year.

readme.note: Select an institution and keep Access to Information Act and Privacy Act results separate when comparing years. Use its research workspace to collect public disclosure citations and edit a request draft; a missing publisher match does not prove that no relevant records exist.

title: What the Minister Was Prepared to Say
description: Compare Question Period notes and the issues they address.

data_info.detail: Federal departments publish bilingual Question Period notes with prepared ministerial responses.

readme.note: Select two notes to compare their prepared questions, responses and background, including the source’s redactions. These are briefing preparations, so do not read the comparison as a transcript of what a minister actually said.

title: The Government’s Wrongdoing Files
description: Read published findings, recommendations and corrective actions.

data_info.detail: Federal disclosures describe founded wrongdoing and the department’s response.

readme.note: Filter by institution, year or finding category, then read the published case description and corrective response together. The index covers published founded cases and cannot measure all complaints or an institution’s overall prevalence of wrongdoing.

title: Algorithm Watch
description: Explore the federal AI register and find matched impact assessments.

data_info.detail: Entries from Canada’s AI Register link to verified impact assessments where available.

readme.note: Filter the register by institution, status or personal-information use and open the original fields before exporting your selection. An unknown impact level means no verified assessment join is available; blank source fields remain unreported.

title: The Government Dataset Explorer
description: Find federal datasets and their downloadable files.

data_info.detail: Canada’s Open Government Portal lists each dataset’s publisher and available file formats.

readme.note: Search the downloaded federal catalogue, or use Live catalogue search for a current CKAN query. Preview CSV and JSON resources up to 2 MB when the publisher allows browser access. You can also open a local CSV or JSON extract without uploading it; previews show up to 50 rows and 30 columns.

title: The Open Data Graveyard
description: Investigate datasets removed from the federal catalogue.

data_info.detail: Treasury Board lists records removed from the federal open-data portal.

readme.note: Search a removed listing and follow its original URL, archive search and related-current-release links. A catalogue deletion supplies a timestamp and identifier, but does not explain the removal or prove the underlying data was destroyed.

title: Canada.ca Pulse
description: Explore recent patterns in federal government website usage.

data_info.detail: Employment and Social Development Canada publishes monthly measures of Canada.ca usage and services.

readme.note: Choose series and a date range, inspect monthly values, and optionally index each series to its first positive observation. Locally saved annotations can mark a service change; matching timing does not establish why traffic changed.

title: Salmon Lines
description: Read annual Pacific salmon returns for a river, compare spawning estimates and inspect survey records.

data_info.detail: DFO’s NuSEDS records spawning estimates by population, waterbody and year, with separate fields for adult spawners and total returns.

readme.note: Read the latest and preceding estimates for one river, population and measure. For Chilliwack River coho, compare the survey years with the Bench Road repair timeline.

dataset.title: Pacific salmon escapement records from DFO NuSEDS

title: Dataset Diff
description: Compare CSV or GeoJSON snapshots by record ID and inspect changes to fields and geometry.

data_info.detail: Both CSV or GeoJSON files stay in your browser while it matches records by the ID you choose.
data_info.install_detail: Your collector stores dated copies of a file or HTTPS feed in SQLite.

readme.note: Compare the 2020 and 2023 Nova Scotia bridge releases by record_id. Four of the nine Annapolis County bridges changed Level 1 rating. Open ANN002 to see Anderson Brook Bridge move from 3 to 2.

title: Corporate Ghosts
description: Search federal corporations, current and historical BC registrations, and Nova Scotia co-operatives by name or registry ID.

data_info.detail: Federal register snapshots, live BC OrgBook search and the published Nova Scotia co-operative list cover different jurisdictions.

readme.note: Open BC historical registrations and look for GLOBAL TELEGRAPH LIMITED (BC0401241). In Nova Scotia, ABC HOUSING CO-OPERATIVE LIMITED is registry ID 3057952. Take an NS ID to RJSC Connect for the official file.

title: Lobby Trail
description: Explore reported federal lobbying communications by organization, subject and institution.

data_info.detail: Federal lobbying reports identify the organizations reporting in-house communications with public office holders.

readme.note: Select an organization, narrow its communication reports by year, institution or subject, and export the matching reports. Each report counts once even when several subjects are named; consultant registrations are outside this index.

title: Charity Flows
description: Compare Canadian charity filings and explore grants to reported recipients.

data_info.detail: CRA charity filings report finances and gifts to qualified donees.

readme.note: Find a charity by name or business number, compare its available fiscal periods and follow exact business-number matches in the gifts panel. The table and CSV show the 40 largest gift entries per period, while totals cover all matched gifts in the selected filing.

title: Tariff X-Ray
description: See what internet providers pay Bell and TELUS for Canadian wholesale fibre access, capacity and installation.

data_info.detail: The listed Bell and TELUS wholesale fibre rates come from two CRTC orders.

readme.note: An internet provider pays Bell or TELUS for use of its Canadian network. For Bell in Ontario and Quebec, the 2026 order lists CAD $68.26 per access in the 3–1,500 Mbps tier, with capacity and installation priced separately.

title: Gear Autopsy
description: Find device filings and public FCC exhibits by model or FCC ID.

data_info.detail: The tool links selected devices to their reviewed FCC equipment exhibits.

readme.note: Search a device or FCC ID, narrow the exhibit types and open the original filing or independent reference. Confirm the hardware variant against the filing before using its exhibits; the app links to documents rather than republishing them.

title: Recall Radar
description: Search Canadian safety alerts and check affected vehicle makes, models and years.

data_info.detail: Health Canada recall notices appear alongside Transport Canada’s 60-day vehicle recall file.

readme.note: Save a product or brand as a search term, then revisit to check matching notices and read the issuing agency’s instructions. The watchlist runs when you visit and does not send background notifications.

title: Patent Attic
description: Look up Canadian pre-grant applications by title, applicant, IPC class or number, and explore older technology publications.

data_info.detail: CIPO’s weekly pre-grant queue and 22 individually checked technology publications are searchable collections.

readme.note: Search 3016489 to inspect the Gearing System application in the November 17, 2026 pre-grant edition, or G01S to find applications in its IPC subclass. Each queue entry identifies the final fee date, applicant, classification and queue position. For the historical collection choose Selected technology publications and search Autofocus.

title: Trailglass
description: Inspect mapped trails or GPX rides, find steep sections and compare recorded elevations with optional terrain estimates.

data_info.detail: Municipal geometry and local GPX tracks, with optional 90 m Copernicus terrain estimates through Open-Meteo. Coordinates are sent only on an explicit terrain request.

readme.note: Select a municipal segment or open a local GPX to inspect distance, recorded elevations and steep sections. You can explicitly send up to 100 sampled coordinates for a separate Open-Meteo terrain profile. The roughly 90 m terrain model does not replace recorded elevations and can miss bridges, tunnels and small climbs.

title: Weather Archive
description: Compare up to 30 years of daily Canadian station weather, inspect monthly tables and export measurements with their flags.

data_info.detail: ECCC supplies daily records and available monthly normals. The tool follows every results page for the selected stations and dates.

readme.note: Compare all of 2024 at Langley and Halifax, inspect the daily table one month at a time and download both stations in a single CSV. Blank measurements keep their place in the record.

title: Spectrum Atlas
description: Find licensed radio sites and compare frequency assignments across Canada.

data_info.detail: ISED’s two technical extracts cover all ten provinces and three territories. Filter the selected region by frequency, site or distance.

readme.note: Choose Nunavut and the Iqaluit city preset, then switch from fixed authorizations to terrestrial sites. The radius sorts matches by straight-line distance from the selected centre. Export the matching coordinates and frequencies.

title: Shipwreck Explorer
description: Search Nova Scotia shipwreck reports and explore documented wreck sites near Tobermory, Ontario.

data_info.detail: Nova Scotia’s marine heritage register and Parks Canada’s Fathom Five guides supply two regional collections.

readme.note: Choose Ontario · Tobermory to map 18 Parks Canada sites. Open Arabia to see its recorded loss and the original site guide, or return to the Nova Scotia archive to compare wrecks around Sable Island.

title: Forgotten Places
description: Explore sites in Canada’s historic places register.

data_info.detail: Parks Canada’s register supplies the records of federally designated heritage places.

readme.note: Search a locality or choose a theme, then open the original designation and its historical description. Theme matches describe archive wording and do not establish current abandonment, access permission or a site’s physical condition.

title: Names That Time Forgot
description: Trace Canadian place names, features and their locations.

data_info.detail: The Canadian Geographical Names Database supplies names for land and underwater features.

readme.note: Choose a province, territory or undersea area and search a name, feature type or reference locality. Map points are published reference coordinates rather than boundaries or entrances; use the official lookup to investigate historical name status.

title: BC Place Names Explorer
description: Explore nearby BC place names, official and recorded names, and naming decisions.

data_info.detail: The BC Geographical Names service returns matches for the name or location you choose.

readme.note: Search a name or nearby coordinates, inspect a naming decision and export the visible page as CSV or GeoJSON. Nearby official-status filtering applies to the current page only, and a reference point is not a feature boundary or entrance.

title: Hidden Water
description: Explore mapped Langley waterways and follow a Fraser Valley fish crossing from barrier assessment to completed repair.

data_info.detail: Langley maps trace channels and culverts. BC fish-passage records document the assessment, habitat and repair of crossing 1474.

readme.note: At Chilliwack Bench, compare the verified habitat length in the database with the length of habitat the project report says became accessible.

title: Halifax Time Lens
description: Compare Halifax aerials from 1947 and 1977 with a 2025 satellite view and find nearby archival photographs.

data_info.detail: NRCan aerial mosaics, a dated Copernicus Sentinel-2C image and Halifax Municipal Archives photographs anchor the comparison.

readme.note: Choose the 2025 satellite layer on either side to compare the harbour with an earlier aerial mosaic. Start with Cogswell and Scotia Square to compare the blocks before clearance with the 1977 mosaic, then open the 1961 photograph and the later demolition view. At the ferry terminal, see the closest 1955 and 2001 archive references within one kilometre, show the indexed points on both maps, and save references to a downloadable GeoJSON notebook.

title: Langley Changes
description: Follow Langley development applications and see when Township building permits appeared or left the active list.

data_info.detail: City and Township planning records include application status and original documents. The Township active permit list provides folder numbers, issue dates, project descriptions and civic addresses.

readme.note: Search a street to see which permit folders were listed there, then open a folder to compare its issue date with the first and last times CoolCode saw it.

title: Langley Trades
description: Search the Township of Langley business-licence file by trade, name or street, and see which names arrived or left since the previous file.

data_info.detail: The Township of Langley open-data business-licence layer supplies the name, trade, civic address, community and phone already published on the licence directory.

readme.note: Type any trade, not only the buttons. A name that is missing from a partial extract is not treated as closed. Phone numbers and streets are only the ones the Township already published.

title: Highway Frame
description: Look up a B.C. highway camera and see the latest still DriveBC is serving, without the rest of the DriveBC site.

data_info.detail: The DriveBC HighwayCams list supplies camera names, highways and picture addresses. The stills themselves are requested from DriveBC when you open a camera.

readme.note: A highway number matches that highway only, so 1 does not include 10. The buttons are shortcuts. Any place name in the camera list works. The still is requested from DriveBC when the frame opens, and it is the current picture, not one from the day the list was saved.

title: Violation Sheet
description: Compare police-reported crime rates for a B.C. police service with the previous published year and with the provincial rate.

data_info.detail: Statistics Canada table 35-10-0184 supplies annual police-reported incidents and rates per 100,000 for British Columbia police services.

readme.note: Pick any police service in the extract, not only the buttons. A year StatCan left blank is shown as not published and is not counted as zero. The rate is incidents per 100,000 population.

title: Strange Skies Canada
description: Search aviation occurrence reports by location, year and event.

data_info.detail: Transport Canada’s CADORS reports describe aviation occurrences, events and the aircraft involved.

readme.note: Search a CADORS number or select a year and event category, then copy the report number into Transport Canada’s original query. The bulk files omit narratives, and the combined balloon, meteor, rocket and CIRVIS/UFO category does not establish an explanation.

title: Lightkeeper
description: Explore Canadian coastal lights, play their published signals and compare nearby aids.

data_info.detail: The Coast Guard’s List of Lights gives each light’s position, colour and flash pattern.

readme.note: Choose a light station and compare its character with neighbouring signals, or try Identify mode with playback started on request. Schematic flash widths are labelled when source timings are absent; use current official publications for navigation.

title: Storm Tracks
description: Replay Atlantic storm tracks and compare how high the water rose above predicted tides during Fiona and Dorian.

data_info.detail: NOAA tracks describe storm positions and winds. Canadian Hydrographic Service gauges show measured water levels alongside tide predictions.

readme.note: Move through a 48-hour storm window to compare the same quarter hour at each gauge and see how many readings support each peak.

title: Nightfinder
description: Plan dark-sky sessions, camera framing and seven days of golden and blue-hour photography windows.

data_info.detail: Sun, Moon and target positions are calculated locally. Optional cloud forecasts come from Open-Meteo only when requested.

readme.note: Choose a location to calculate seven days of golden light (Sun −4° to +6°) and blue light (−6° to −4°), alongside dark-sky target sessions. Optionally load cloud-cover forecasts for those windows; that click sends coordinates to Open-Meteo. Download the plan to retain the calculated windows.

title: Satellite Pass
description: Calculate passes for the ISS and other satellites from your location.

data_info.detail: Your browser uses orbital elements from CelesTrak to calculate satellite passes for your location.

readme.note: Calculate passes for your location and chosen minimum elevation, filter to likely visible windows, and download the shown passes as CSV or an ICS calendar. The calendar is a dated export, not a live subscription; refresh orbital elements and recalculate before observing.

title: Sky Archive Explorer
description: Find selected Hubble and Webb observations and open the original archive records.

data_info.detail: The MAST archive supplies selected Hubble and Webb observations of five targets.

readme.note: Search the selected observation index, inspect a record’s dates and instruments, and request its source preview or export metadata. Use Search all of MAST for arbitrary targets; the local selection is not the full archive and individual products can require additional attribution.

title: NASA Overhead
description: A daily NASA briefing for Canada: Earth from L1, this week's asteroid flybys, aurora odds for your places, solar activity and open natural events.

data_info.detail: Daily captures of NASA's APOD, asteroid, space-weather, EPIC and EONET data plus NOAA's Kp forecast.

readme.note: Each day's build saves a dated capture. Use the Capture menu to compare earlier days. The asteroid chart plots each close approach by date and by distance in lunar distances (LD, about 384,400 km) on a log scale. Anything below the dashed line passes inside the Moon's orbit. "Potentially hazardous" is NASA's orbital class, not a risk for this week. For the aurora, a city with a geomagnetic latitude of about 54° (Vancouver, Halifax) typically needs Kp 6 or higher to see a glow on the northern horizon. Add your own place as "Name, latitude, longitude", for example "Whitehorse, 60.72, -135.06". APOD uses NASA’s APOD Basic feed: each entry links to its dated article, with an image, video, or article-only fallback. A successful daily capture can contain a source error; its public source results show which feeds were unavailable.

title: Photo Lab
description: Inspect photo metadata, compare file hashes, edit images and verify sanitized JPEG/PNG copies or a batch ZIP locally.

data_info.detail: Files stay in your browser. JPEG/PNG exports are re-inspected for metadata; Content Credentials detection does not validate signatures. The included Earthrise photograph comes from NASA.

readme.note: Open JPEG or PNG photos to inspect EXIF, GPS, text and other metadata in the Privacy desk. Edit a selected photo, then export a copy: Photo Lab re-inspects the actual output and compares its SHA-256 and metadata with the original. For a group of photos, prepare a verified ZIP with neutral filenames. HEIC is identified but cannot be edited or sanitized here.

title: Otherworld Names
description: Compare shared Moon and Mars names, explore their origins, and find low-angle sunlight at lunar craters from Langley or Halifax.

data_info.detail: USGS/IAU feature centres and JPL Horizons ephemerides support the lunar observing planner. Hourly ECCC cloud forecasts are available on demand.

readme.note: Open One name, two worlds and compare Balboa. The lunar crater honours Vasco Nuñez de Balboa, while its Martian namesake takes its name from a town in Panama. Try Copernicus or Adams, then locate either feature in the atlas. The November edition has 134 shared spellings after excluding lettered satellite features.

title: BankRate Lab
description: Chart Bank of Canada rates, exchange rates and yields.

data_info.detail: The Bank of Canada publishes the interest rates, bond yields and Canadian-dollar exchange rates shown here.

readme.note: Choose a date range and use the date inspector or data table to compare rates with matching units. Indexed FX starts each series at its first available observation, while CSV exports preserve original exchange rates and blank observations.

title: Canadian Price Atlas
description: Compare historical grocery prices across Canadian regions.

data_info.detail: Statistics Canada publishes monthly retail prices for Canada, BC and Nova Scotia.

readme.note: Add products and package quantities to a basket, then compare exact endpoint months across your selected areas. Missing prices are listed rather than filled; exports retain the published package observations and Statistics Canada vector identifiers.

title: Insolvency Atlas
description: Explore insolvency counts and rates, or compare filings with grocery prices and policy rates.

data_info.detail: The Office of the Superintendent of Bankruptcy publishes monthly filing counts and annual insolvency rates.

readme.note: Compare filings or official annual rates for selected regions, then export the same range as CSV. Incomplete years stay blank, and consumer and business rates use different denominators, so compare like measures.

title: Market Shadows
description: Read CIRO short-sale summaries, signed trading corrections and short positions in your browser.

data_info.detail: Open CIRO summary, trading corrections and position files or paste original report rows.

readme.note: Open a CIRO corrections CSV to see the signed change in shares alongside the original trade period. For summaries or positions, open two reporting dates to rank changes by security.

title: Event Radar
description: Find shows and community events in 37 Canadian cities and save outings from several cities to one calendar.

data_info.detail: Has Things supplies local showtimes across all ten provinces and three territories. Langley links to venue calendars.

readme.note: Choose a city, filter its showtimes and add events from several cities to one downloadable calendar. Plans and imported calendars last only for the current tab; download before leaving and check organizer details for unlisted times or changed availability.

title: Atlantic Dial
description: Find Atlantic Canadian radio shows on your clock and listen to recent episodes from local stations.

data_info.detail: Stations publish the broadcast times and episode feeds. Choose your time zone or search recent recordings by title.
data_info.cadence: Daily episode imports and weekly schedule checks

readme.note: Search Nain for Labrador broadcasts, or open Field recordings and search William Riley to hear him sing in Cherry Brook. Each recording opens at its original tape cue. On demand includes two programmes about Halifax donairs. Only currently verified station listings produce upcoming airings; unconfirmed listings are retained separately for review.

title: Screen Radar
description: Find television and Canadian films, and keep a watchlist in this browser.

data_info.detail: TV searches use TVmaze, and the selected Canadian films come from Wikidata.

readme.note: Search TVmaze or filter the Canadian film shelf, then save titles to this browser’s watchlist and export it as CSV. Source records provide credits and release information; the app does not establish current streaming availability.

title: Media Echoes
description: Pinpoint old software, Flash projects and media by title, creator, collection, year and exclusions.

data_info.detail: Internet Archive returns catalogue records, previews and file lists when you search.

readme.note: Use Encarta software · 1995 to narrow the search to software records with Encarta in the title and a catalogue date in 1995. The source search included Microsoft Encarta ’95 (1995 MPEG Edition), identifier encarta95. Inspect its files or refine the search by creator. The Myst software · 1993 and Homestar Runner · Flash shortcuts also combine title and collection or year filters.

title: Ghost Links
description: Follow dead URLs through web archives and dated captures.

data_info.detail: Reviewed Canadian web-address histories can be explored alongside optional Wayback checks or local imports.

readme.note: Paste up to 50 public URLs into the batch checker to find nearby Wayback captures and download a dated JSON receipt. Current HTTP checks are optional. A browser restriction, timeout or blocked HEAD request is inconclusive, not proof that the page is dead.

title: Lost Code
description: Look up archived repository visits, branches and tags.

data_info.detail: Software Heritage supplies archived origins, crawl visits and branches for each lookup.

readme.note: Search a project name or public repository URL, select an archive visit, and inspect its preserved branches or tags. A visit is an archive observation; missing or partial captures do not establish whether the source survives elsewhere.

title: The Unreleased Worlds Index
description: Search a Canada Media Fund export for funded games, films and digital projects.

data_info.detail: The tool reads the Canada Media Fund project export you select on your device.

readme.note: Download an official CMF export, open it locally and correct its column mapping before filtering or adding rows to the research queue. A funded-project row is not proof of release or cancellation, and the imported file and queue stay in the current tab.

title: Clam Grounds
description: Explore Maritime clam habitat, reported and confidential landings, and Nova Scotia’s 1931 returns.

data_info.detail: DFO reports habitat and annual commercial landings. The 1931 fisheries return gives clam barrels and canned cases for ten Nova Scotia counties.

readme.note: Compare Nova Scotia and New Brunswick over the same years to see where DFO published landings or marked them x for confidentiality. For a local historical view, choose a county in the 1931 returns and check its barrels or canned cases against the linked scan of page 84.

title: Ferry Counts
description: Compare hourly passenger patterns on Halifax harbour ferries and Vancouver’s SeaBus.

data_info.detail: Halifax Transit supplies dated boarding counts and TransLink publishes seasonal SeaBus averages by hour and direction.
data_info.cadence: Weekly Halifax · Monthly SeaBus edition check

readme.note: Compare Halifax to Alderney against the return direction on weekdays. Expand the hourly figures to see how many dates contributed to each average, or download the comparison as CSV. Switch to Vancouver Harbour to compare SeaBus volumes by direction, season and day type.

title: Well Layers
description: Pick a depth to read every sampled Langley and rural Halifax well log, or compare two drillers’ exact intervals side by side.

data_info.detail: B.C. GWELLS descriptions and Nova Scotia well-log material codes supply source intervals, gaps and drilling observations.

readme.note: At 20 m, Langley 30145 records “coarse sand” and Hammonds Plains 000119 records “shale / unknown”. Use the paired example to read both intervals, then open the all-logs table to see what every sampled well records at that same depth. Switch units without moving the selected physical depth. The table distinguishes explicit unknown terms, an empty material field, overlapping intervals, gaps and the end of a log.

title: Camp Calendar
description: Compare how far ahead campers booked at Nova Scotia provincial parks, two parks at a time.

data_info.detail: Overnight reservations from Nova Scotia’s provincial parks show how far ahead campers booked their trips.

readme.note: Select July, RV and Friday or Saturday to compare the booking lead time at Rissers Beach with Graves Island. The percentile range covers the middle half of successful bookings.

title: Snow Courses
description: Follow a winter at a B.C. snow station and compare snow depth or water equivalent with earlier seasons.

data_info.detail: Provincial surveyors measure snow courses and automated instruments report readings from Fraser basin stations.

readme.note: Try Grouse Mountain’s April survey, then select Barkerville under Automated station to compare the same date across earlier winters. Follow the full October–September season against earlier same-period medians, inspect sample sizes and share the station, measurement, date and year in one link.

title: Prefix Diary
description: Look up Canadian telephone assignments and trace IPv4 or IPv6 registration blocks across ARIN reports.

data_info.detail: The Canadian Numbering Administrator supplies telephone assignments. ARIN publishes dated IPv4 and IPv6 delegations by registration economy.

readme.note: Search 902 and Halifax for telephone assignments. In Canadian IP registrations, compare UBC’s IPv4 block or BCNET’s IPv6 block in the 2016, 2020 and latest ARIN editions, then open its observed routing history.

title: Coal Below
description: Explore Nova Scotia coal seams and underground workings against modern streets, then inspect the original provincial records.

data_info.detail: Nova Scotia Geological Survey coal seam and mine workings layers appear over an OpenStreetMap basemap.

readme.note: Start with modern streets and landmarks beneath the Springhill coalfield. Toggle the seam lines and shaded workings separately, then select a workings outline to read its mapped area and mine-plan note. The three Sydney Mines, Florence and Point Aconi workings areas share a seam layer and appear together in the area selector.

title: Ice Weeks
description: Compare the same winter week on Canadian Ice Service concentration charts for the East Coast, including the Gulf of St. Lawrence.

data_info.detail: Canadian Ice Service charts show weekly East Coast ice concentration across winters.

readme.note: Choose winters 2025–2026 and 2024–2025 and move to week 12 to compare the charts issued February 16, 2026 and February 17, 2025. An empty panel means the archive index has no chart in that week.

title: Ferry Record
description: Trace service on a BC ferry route, compare quarters and read the original operations reports.

data_info.detail: BC Ferries reports actual round trips and vehicle capacity by route. A 2013 provincial briefing documents passenger-only services to Bowen Island.

readme.note: On Route 08, compare the quarters ending June 2025 and June 2026. The operator recorded 1,386 and 1,384 round trips respectively, while passenger totals rose from 374,200 to 387,857.

title: Schoolhouse Ledger
description: Compare enrolment, daily attendance and spending in historic Lower Mainland schools.

data_info.detail: BC’s 1894–95 schools report records enrolment and average attendance across school years, alongside each school’s expenditure in the report year.

readme.note: In 1894–95 Langley enrolled 32 pupils and averaged 19.79 present each day. Langley East enrolled 23 and averaged 12.85. Earlier attendance tables and the report-year financial figures cover different periods.

title: Spill Ledger
description: Follow marine pollution incidents in BC and Nova Scotia through claims, offers and recoveries.

data_info.detail: A federal compensation fund’s 2023–24 report lists incidents and financial decisions, including preventive responses and cases with several claimants.

readme.note: The June 2015 Farley Mowat incident in Shelburne has separate claims by the town and the Canadian Coast Guard. Select the incident to compare the amounts submitted and offered, alongside the shared recovery entry.

title: Pantry Prices
description: Compare Canadian grocery baskets across time and follow world coffee prices to supermarket shelves in BC and Nova Scotia.

data_info.detail: Historical surveys and Statistics Canada scanner prices track groceries. World Bank and Bank of Canada monthly data put Arabica and provincial coffee prices on a common baseline.

dataset.title: Arabica benchmark and retail coffee in BC and Nova Scotia

readme.note: One 454 g butter, one 675 g white bread and a dozen eggs totalled $9.69 in September 2017 and $13.99 in September 2026 at Canadian scanner averages. Choose a province to compare its prices, or select an earlier price series to explore the published urban and national records back to 1914. In Commodity to shelf, choose a base month to see when Arabica, BC and Nova Scotia retail coffee first rose or fell by the same percentage.

title: Bridge Ledger
description: Look up historical Nova Scotia bridge inspections and compare dated ratings on the same scale.

data_info.detail: Two provincial information releases record bridge inspection dates, types and ratings. The NS Structures Database supplies locations by structure ID.

readme.note: Anderson Brook Bridge in Annapolis County received a general rating of Good on April 22, 2020 and Fair on April 26, 2023. Its detailed inspections use a separate scale. The place link comes from a unique match on the provincial structure ID.

title: Library Workbench
description: Check whether a 3D print fits Halifax or Richmond library limits, estimate Richmond’s fee, or plan a Vancouver tape transfer.

data_info.detail: Library equipment guides, Vancouver usage reports and the Nova Scotia library survey supply the project planners and comparisons.

readme.note: Enter 90 minutes and 30 grams in the 3D print planner. This fits Halifax’s published under-two-hour service and gives a CAD $6.50 estimate in Richmond. At 120 minutes, only the Richmond option meets the published time limit. Try a PAL Hi8 cassette in the Vancouver transfer planner. Enter 60, 90, 45 for three tapes to see 3 h 15 min of real-time copying and roughly 13 GB of storage before setup and saving. Explore Regular 8 film, quarter-inch audio reels or floppy disks in the equipment directory. In the activity table, minutes per session relates reported hours to sessions. Select Halifax in 2024–25 to compare its survey and annual-report figures.

title: Shopfront Diary
description: Compare two historic directories address by address to trace shops, neighbours and recorded vacancies in Halifax and Vancouver.

data_info.detail: Digitized Halifax and Vancouver directories supply selected shop listings and their printed source pages from 1890–1909.

readme.note: Compare Halifax’s 1890–91 and 1899–1900 directories to find the explicit vacancies at 80 and 100–102 Upper Water. On the same street, see both listed occupants at number 54, alongside the earlier 54–56 range. Compare Vancouver in 1901 and 1903 to see John Oben listed at 413 Hastings W in both, alongside different second shop addresses. Each entry links to its source page.

title: Transfer Window
description: See how many scheduled 555 transfers survive a delay at Carvolth or Lougheed and how much time a missed connection adds.

data_info.detail: TransLink’s static GTFS timetable supplies scheduled 555 arrivals, onward departures, bays and service-date exceptions.

readme.note: Choose a morning or evening arrival window at Carvolth or Lougheed. Compare two- to twenty-minute delays to see how many connections hold and which arrivals face the longest added wait.

title: SeaBus Clock
description: Find the busiest SeaBus hours by direction and see the scheduled gap between sailings.

data_info.detail: TransLink publishes seasonal hourly SeaBus volumes and a separate timetable for Waterfront and Lonsdale Quay.

readme.note: Compare fall weekday volumes in each direction, then select a terminal and service date to see the scheduled wait after a missed sailing.

title: Dispatch Ledger
description: Compare Halifax police service demand by agency, reporting channel and period.

data_info.detail: Halifax Board of Police Commissioners reports provide service counts by agency and separate district crime totals.

readme.note: Compare public-generated calls, proactive calls and online reports from January through June in two years. Switch between regional police, the RCMP Halifax Regional Detachment and the published combined figures. The district table counts recorded crime in 2025 and uses a different unit from the service table.

title: Crossing Record
description: Map Langley junctions and compare ICBC crash counts before and after documented road work.

data_info.detail: ICBC supplies approximate junction coordinates and yearly crash counts. Langley City project records identify selected road improvements.

readme.note: Select a dot on the junction map or search by road name. Choose a Langley junction and compare annual averages on either side of a reference year. Douglas Crescent at 203 Street and 56 Avenue at 201A Street have linked, completed city projects. The project year is excluded from both periods. Counts represent crashes reported to ICBC, and the view shows how many years support each average.

title: Park Visits
description: Compare annual visits at Parks Canada places across the country using trend lines and fiscal-year comparisons.

data_info.detail: Parks Canada publishes fiscal-year visits for each place, including reporting gaps and temporary closures.

readme.note: Start with Fort Langley and Halifax Citadel, pick a fiscal year, then compare their trend lines, year bars and full annual table. Counts represent visits and can include repeat visitors. Try Jasper and Gros Morne, or the northern parks Aulavik and Ivvavik.

title: Streetwork Diary
description: Map Halifax street-service requests by community and compare closures and published resolution fields across two weeks.

data_info.detail: Cityworks request counts are mapped to Halifax’s published community boundaries and joined to municipal custom-field records.

readme.note: Choose a shaded community to filter the records for that area. Start with street-surface requests for April 1–7, 2025. Compare closed counts, published resolution coverage and custom-field coverage, then switch to another request type.

title: Route Mirror
description: See which Metro Vancouver bus routes switch their busier direction between peaks and which repeat the pattern every year.

data_info.detail: TransLink publishes average peak passenger loads by route, direction, time band, season, day type and year.

readme.note: Start with route 555 on fall weekdays to see how its westbound morning lead and eastbound afternoon lead change across years. Open the repeat-reversal ranking to compare its smallest lead with other routes.

title: Postmark Places
description: Read a historic postmark by matching its name and date to documented post-office openings, renamings and closures.

data_info.detail: Langley and Dartmouth heritage reports document office names, openings, closures and moves.

readme.note: Compare the “Langley Prairie” postmark in 1910 and 1912. The earlier office became Murrayville on May 16, 1911, the day a different office took the Langley Prairie name. Browse Dartmouth’s history to see how its post office moved between a general store and a purpose-built building. Approximate openings and undocumented closures are labelled on the cards.

title: Lake Profiles
description: Compare dissolved oxygen and temperature at measured depths on different Halifax lake visits.

data_info.detail: Municipal LakeWatchers measurements cover Halifax-area deep-water stations with repeat sampling visits.

readme.note: Choose Lake Banook, compare April 18 and August 14, 2023 at 10 metres, and switch between oxygen and temperature. The plot and table include only measured depths.

title: Forecast Receipt
description: Follow one weather hour at Langley or Halifax from its first saved temperature forecast through later revisions to the airport reading.

data_info.detail: Six-hourly forecast receipts are matched to hourly temperatures from Environment and Climate Change Canada at two airports.

readme.note: Choose a receipt and a station-local hour. The hour history links every available prediction for that hour, its lead time and its error when ECCC has an unflagged reading. The first Langley GFS receipt predicted 3.8 °C for 06:00 UTC on November 19, 2026.

title: Aurora Trace
description: See when a 2024 magnetic storm affected Victoria and St. John’s most differently, and inspect the readings on each coast.

data_info.detail: NASA DONKI links solar eruptions to two 2024 storms, with Canadian ground measurements from INTERMAGNET.

readme.note: Jump to the largest coast-to-coast difference. On October 10 at 23:25 UTC, Victoria was 552 nT above its reference and St. John’s was 622 nT below. Each Kp value covers three hours, while the station readings cover five minutes.

title: Fossil Neighbours
description: Explore the fossils recorded at Joggins and Haslam, then compare Canadian collections whose ages overlap.

data_info.detail: Paleobiology Database collections, occurrence identifications and references document the Joggins and Haslam formations and selected age peers.

readme.note: Start at Coal Mine Point in the Joggins Formation and search for Hylonomus to see how several reported names resolve to one accepted taxon. Switch to Haslam on Vancouver Island to compare its much younger collections with Canadian collections whose age ranges overlap.

title: Sun Ledger
description: Compare the solar energy reaching Langley and Halifax by month and year, alongside NASA’s clear-sky estimate.

data_info.detail: NASA POWER supplies monthly all-sky and clear-sky solar energy for grid areas around Langley, BC, and Halifax, NS.

readme.note: In the 2001–2020 average, December brings 0.68 kWh/m²/day to Langley and 1.14 to Halifax. Select June to see the two sites nearly coincide, then open the monthly ledger to inspect the individual years.

title: Planet Papers
description: Compare published measurements of the same exoplanet, with uncertainties and links to the original papers.

data_info.detail: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems rows preserve separately cited measurements, uncertainties and limits for each planet.

readme.note: Select TRAPPIST-1 e and compare the mass estimates from Gillon (2017), Grimm (2018) and Agol (2021). The plot and table preserve each paper’s uncertainties, while the other solutions remain visible when that paper has no mass estimate.

title: Mass Peaks
description: Find particle peaks by comparing pairs of muons with opposite and matching charges.

data_info.detail: CERN’s CMS outreach sample supplies the reconstructed mass and charges of two muons in 100,000 collision events.

readme.note: Select the J/ψ window, 0.10 GeV/c² bins and both charge selections. In the 3.00 to under 3.10 interval there are 4,512 opposite-charge and 558 same-charge pairs. Switch to percentages to compare each bin with its full charge sample.

title: Air Pair
description: Compare measured air quality with models, explore worldwide pollutant forecasts and compare local station files.

data_info.detail: Saved Canadian monitor/model pairs, opt-in worldwide CAMS forecasts and local hourly CSV comparisons. Model estimates remain distinct from observations.

readme.note: Compare the saved Langley and Lake Major monitor readings with model estimates, then use the broader comparison to explore six pollutants at any two coordinates. Worldwide values are CAMS Global model forecasts. Alternatively, compare two hourly observation CSV files locally, retaining missing hours and calculating differences only where both values exist.

title: Flyby Files
description: See which of six close-passing asteroids astronomers discovered before the flyby, and when old images changed the record.

data_info.detail: JPL’s encounter and orbit records give passage times, distances and first observation dates for selected near-Earth asteroids.

readme.note: Choose 2024 MK. Its present orbit uses a measurement from 2014, while JPL dates its discovery to thirteen days before the 2024 flyby. For 2020 QG, the discovery image came about six hours after closest approach. All six cases link to a NASA or ESA discovery account.

title: Plume Diary
description: Compare the Fraser River’s visible plume on two satellite dates and test whether earlier upstream flows change the story.

data_info.detail: NASA Terra/MODIS true-colour images show the delta at the same scale. Water Survey of Canada supplies daily mean discharge upstream.

readme.note: On June 21 and 28, 2021 the Hope gauge was 680 m³/s higher on the second date. Test all five travel-time assumptions, then compare the green-brown coastal band on June 21 with the lighter patch extending southwest on June 28. The June 14 image shows how cloud can hide the river mouth.

title: Chirp Room
description: Can two distant detectors pick out the same black-hole merger? Align the traces and compare their agreement with an earlier recording window.

data_info.detail: GWOSC supplies calibrated strain from the two LIGO detectors. Each displayed trace is filtered from its own 32-second record.

readme.note: Compare the unadjusted, published and custom alignments over two equal 170 ms windows. Apply the seven-millisecond shift and polarity reversal to see what changes near the merger and earlier in the recording. Press Play to hear the one-second stereo extract.

title: Quake Echo
description: Compare agency estimates of the same Sunshine Coast earthquake and explore where people reported feeling it.

data_info.detail: Earthquakes Canada publishes a reviewed event bulletin. USGS supplies its preferred estimate, dated products and public intensity reports.

readme.note: Search for Sechelt, then compare its community intensity with the preferred Canadian and US magnitudes. Change the minimum response count to see which places are supported by many independent submissions.

title: Aircheck Diary
description: Compare what Halifax and Vancouver logged at the same local hour, find a favourite title and open its original broadcast records.

data_info.detail: CRTC television logs cover two Halifax and two Vancouver stations, starting with all 30 reporting dates in September 2026.

readme.note: Compare September 1, 2026 at 8 p.m. Halifax’s CJCH logged Password while Vancouver’s CIVT logged Jeopardy! Masters. At 10 p.m. the titles trade places. Open a program’s source rows to see the commercial spots and segments filed inside its slot. The official catalogue is checked separately from the retained archive date; an unpublished next month is reported as awaiting publication.

title: Committee Receipt
description: Trace a question from a House of Commons hearing to the page where officials answered it.

data_info.detail: House of Commons transcripts and written follow-ups trace nine questions at four Government Operations hearings from March to May 2020.

readme.note: Look up the tugboat challenge to find the roughly $193,000 on page 2 of the May 22 email. The department measured costs through March 31, and the reply came 71 days after the question.

title: Donair After Dark
description: Price your usual donair order and see which Halifax counters list pickup hours for the time you choose.

data_info.detail: Halifax shop menus supply counter prices, sauce sizes and weekly pickup hours.

readme.note: Try Saturday at 12:45 a.m. to see Friday’s hours carry past midnight at Tony’s and Metro Pizza. Compare two entry-size donairs with the smallest extra sauce, or request exactly 4 oz to see which menus publish that portion. Save your usual basket on this device.

title: Paper Cheque Trail
description: Compare the number, value and share of paper cheques issued by Canadian federal programs each month.

data_info.detail: The Receiver General publishes monthly domestic payment counts and amounts by department, product and payment method.

readme.note: In October 2026, Old Age Security issued 172,555 cheques among 7,554,966 payments. Switch to count share to see 2.28%, compare it with CPP and open the monthly values for the source row behind either figure.

title: Same Flight
description: Compare the decisions and individual orders published about passengers on the same departure.

data_info.detail: CTA summaries cover nine departures on December 23, 2023 and January 27, 2024. Compare published decisions and orders, or import a filtered agency export locally.

readme.note: Flair F81100 from Montréal to Fort Lauderdale has 22 inconvenience-compensation decisions and four dismissals. On WestJet WS1877 from Kahului to Vancouver, seven decisions contain 13 order rows. Filter the issue or remedy to see how a single decision can appear in several counts.

title: Last Refill
description: Find the longest gap between mapped drinking fountains on a private Vancouver GPX route.

data_info.detail: City of Vancouver fountain, washroom, boundary and bikeway records are matched to a local route.

readme.note: On the English Bay ride, compare posted year-round fountains with all mapped seasons. The Second Beach pool-deck fountain appears in the second view. Open a GPX to see distances along your own track, washroom hours and the kilometres where Vancouver’s municipal coverage ends.

title: Meter Math
description: Compare entire-visit parking costs and posted restrictions at Vancouver meter zones.

data_info.detail: City of Vancouver meter records supply time-of-day rates, duration limits and restrictions.

readme.note: Try a Friday from 5:30 to 7 p.m. near the Vancouver Art Gallery. Compare the two featured zones, then expand a meter row to see the charge on either side of 6 p.m. Switch the result group to see which posted limits or restrictions affect the same visit.

title: Signal Walk
description: Align two Android cellular surveys at named checkpoints to compare signal, serving-cell changes and phone state.

data_info.detail: Android Network Survey LTE, NR and phone-state CSVs are read in your browser.

readme.note: Select each walk’s LTE, NR and phone-state CSVs together, then enter the elapsed time for the same landmark in both recordings. The report uses relative times and numeric checkpoint labels so locations and identifiers stay out of the export.

title: Last-Mile Percentile
description: Compare your download or upload speed with tests on the same network in a Canadian city.

data_info.detail: Measurement Lab publishes monthly speed percentiles and test counts by city and network.

readme.note: Choose a month, city and network, then enter your speed in Mbps. Each comparison shows the two published boundaries around your result and the number of tests behind them.

title: Drive Cohort
description: Look up an exact drive model in Backblaze’s quarterly fleet history and compare two local SMART reports.

data_info.detail: Backblaze’s quarterly production fleet tables supply model counts, drive-days and failures. Optional smartctl reports stay on your device.

readme.note: Look up ST12000NM0007 and compare Q1 and Q2 2025. Backblaze recorded 24 failures across 92,483 drive-days in Q1 and nine across 91,801 in Q2. Bring two smartctl JSON files from the same disk to see what changed on your own device.

title: Federal Property Atlas
description: Locate federal parcels by community, custodian and legal interest. Inspect building area and follow a property into the federal heritage and contaminated-sites records.

data_info.detail: Treasury Board lists land, buildings and custodians in BC and Nova Scotia. Reviewed Parks Canada records identify selected heritage designations.

readme.note: Search Fisgard in British Columbia and open property 17454. The March 2026 heritage directory links this property to a national historic site, a classified federal heritage building and a heritage lighthouse.

title: Inflation Basket
description: Compare the change in your own spending basket with official provincial or Canadian inflation over the same months.

data_info.detail: Statistics Canada publishes monthly price indexes for eight spending categories and all-items CPI, with separate basket weights.

readme.note: Set every category except food to zero to isolate food inflation. In BC from October 2025 to October 2026 the food index rose 2.37% and the official all-items index rose 2.51%. The contribution table shows exactly which spending categories drive a custom result.

title: Spectrum Explorer
description: Look up a Canadian frequency band and compare published transmitter records by province and territory.

data_info.detail: ISED’s Canadian allocation table is paired with counts from the terrestrial spectrum licence site extract.

readme.note: Enter 3550 MHz to open the 3500–3650 MHz band. Compare BC and Nova Scotia in the regional table and follow the link to Spectrum Atlas to inspect individual sites.

title: ASN Canada
description: Find a Canadian-registered network and compare its visible IPv4 and IPv6 announcements.

data_info.detail: RIPEstat lists Canadian ASN registrations and routing visibility. RIPE RIS supplies prefix counts by family and advertisement length.

readme.note: Try AS852. The November 19, 2026 RIS tables show 683 IPv4 prefixes and 30 IPv6 prefixes for TELUS after the ten-peer threshold. Switch address family to inspect its advertised prefix lengths or open the RIPEstat source.

title: Range Ledger
description: Follow the IP ranges published by Cloudflare, AWS, Google Cloud, Fastly, Oracle and GitHub, see what changed each day, and check any address.

data_info.detail: Daily snapshots of the IP range files Cloudflare, AWS, Google Cloud, Fastly, Oracle Cloud and GitHub publish, with day-by-day changes.

readme.note: Paste an address into "Check an address" to see which provider publishes it, in which region or service, and whether that region is Canadian. "What changed" lists, by day, every prefix a provider added or removed. A move between regions shows as one removal and one addition. "Build an allowlist" turns a provider's current list, filtered by family, region, service or Canadian regions, into plain text, nginx `allow` rules or CSV. Rebuild from the newest snapshot before you rely on one. A provider marked "stale" couldn't be refreshed that day and shows its last good list.

title: CanCon Atlas
description: Find a recording in the CRTC music database and inspect its Canadian-content decision, language and release details.

data_info.detail: The CRTC publishes selection-level Canadian-content decisions, artists, languages, release dates and recording identifiers.

readme.note: Search the October 2026 edition for Gord Bamford or paste an ISRC. The count shows matching selection rows. Browse different recordings of the same song and check each row’s Canadian-content status.

title: Census Lens
description: Compare two Canadian communities on population, housing, income, education and language using the 2021 Census.

data_info.detail: Statistics Canada’s 2021 Census Profile supplies 16 indicators for communities, metropolitan areas, provinces and territories across Canada.

readme.note: Search Langley and switch between the district municipality and the city. The 2021 Census reports 132,603 residents in the district municipality and 28,963 in the city. Compare either one with Halifax Regional Municipality, then select median age or the tenant share.

title: Housing Pulse
description: Compare housing construction, vacancy and rent in Halifax, Vancouver and other Canadian markets.

data_info.detail: CMHC surveys and Statistics Canada rent estimates cover construction, vacancy, completed inventory and quarterly asking and paid rents.

readme.note: Compare Halifax and Vancouver for a two-bedroom apartment in the second quarter of 2026. Average asking rents were $2,400 and $3,030, while average paid rents were $1,770 and $2,470. Switch to rental housing starts to explore a different source and monthly reporting period.

title: FreeNet Echo
description: Compare archived homepages and documented services of community networks in Halifax, Vancouver and Ottawa.

data_info.detail: Internet Archive capture metadata and the networks’ own histories document homepages, services and milestones.

readme.note: Pick Halifax and Vancouver, then select a year to compare the available homepage captures. Follow a dated snapshot or inspect the source explaining when each network offered a service.

title: Toxic Ground
description: Trace the investigation of a recorded site. Compare its contaminants, annual expenditures and highest completed management step across fiscal years.

data_info.detail: The Federal Contaminated Sites Inventory reports site status, contaminants, fiscal expenditures and management steps in BC and Nova Scotia.

readme.note: Search Halifax for Willow Park (4327) - TEME North Site. Its fiscal rows let you compare remediation spending with the highest completed step. Use the federal site ID to revisit the same entry after a source update.

title: Surplus Crown
description: Follow federal sale listings, land identified for housing and Nova Scotia’s recorded land disposals. See which source supports each status and price.

data_info.detail: PSPC publishes federal sale listings and housing land-bank records. Nova Scotia reports completed provincial property disposals by fiscal year.

readme.note: Search Upper Tantallon to compare the Nova Scotia disposal files and the contract prices recorded for different parcels. Choose Federal sale listing to see asking prices separately. Provincial files have no parcel coordinates.

title: Cloud Ledger
description: Compare federal contract disclosures for selected cloud and IT suppliers by department, reporting quarter and instrument.

data_info.detail: Treasury Board contract disclosures preserve filed vendor names and distinguish original awards from amendments.

readme.note: Filter to ThinkOn and open reference C-2026-2027-Q2-00919. The RCMP reported an original contract value of $192,894.74 in 2026–27 Q2. Selecting amendments instead shows the signed changes disclosed for that vendor.

title: CCTS Ledger
description: Compare telecom providers across CCTS annual reports and examine the issues raised in an official workbook privately.
